title: The sync gate's pool check on a retry after a rejected push judges the rebased tree against the landing itself, so upstream pool defects refuse the landing
goal: kg_sync.gate takes the base of the pool check from the merge base of the upstream and HEAD on a retry too, so only defects the landing adds refuse it

run:
import re, sys
s = open("_tools/kg_sync.py", encoding="utf-8").read()
m = re.search(r"base_rev = (.*)", s)
print(m.group(0) if m else "no base_rev line")
sys.exit(1 if m and m.group(1).startswith("since or") else 0)

repro_reason: a retry after a rejected push needs two clones and an upstream delta that changes a pool input and adds a pool defect; the line that picks the base is the reading

run: import sys; sys.path.insert(0, "_tools"); import kg_sync as k; seen = {}; pool = "kb/public/_retrieval/bench_pool.csv"; k.dirty_paths = lambda: ([], []); k.names = lambda *a: [pool]; k.git = lambda *a: "MERGEBASE\n" if a[:1] == ("merge-base",) else ""; k.tool = lambda name, *a, env=None: (0, ""); k.pool_gate = lambda code, out, base: (seen.setdefault("base", base), (code, out))[1]; k.heldout_checks = lambda paths: []; k.gate_paths = lambda up: {pool}; host = type("H", (), {"audit": lambda s, rng, quiet=False: (0, 0, [])})(); k.gate({"target": "main"}, "origin/main", host, since="GATEDSHA"); print("pool check base on a retry:", seen.get("base")); sys.exit(0 if seen.get("base") == "MERGEBASE" else 1)

notes: Found by the SP-s5k72bhd review of BG-2mdkl622 (headless reviewer session 1b63a864; read from the code, not reproduced as a two-clone retry). It can only refuse falsely, never pass falsely: attempt 1 already passed. The first attempt uses the merge base of the upstream and HEAD, which is also the right base after a rebase. Premise run 2026-10-24 on the day-run base: repro exits 1 (base_rev line starts with since or). A planted check was added at planning: kg_sync.gate run with since set and its collaborators replaced, asserting the base pool_gate receives is the merge base; it fails on the base (prints the since commit). The fix lives in the base_rev line only. Planned into SP-yisvj7vd, 2026-10-24.
